maddeler.e:
استقضين (form X)
# اِسْتَقْضَيْنَ (istaqḍayna) /is.taq.dˤaj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَقْضَى (istaqḍā)
# اُسْتُقْضِينَ (ustuqḍīna) /us.tuq.dˤiː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَقْضَى (istaqḍā)
# اِسْتَقْضِينَ (istaqḍīna) /is.taq.dˤiː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَقْضَى (istaqḍā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
